blind.description: A small arched stone masonry niche or columbarium alcove holding three lidded ceramic burial urns. The frame consists of chiseled dark grey stone blocks with a prominent keystone and a flat base shelf. Inside sit three distinct painted urns: an orange-terracotta urn on the left, a crimson-red urn in the center, and a cream-colored urn with green decorative bands on the right. Surfaces are solid and stylized with hand-painted textures.
blind.from_above: A rounded rectangular stone arch top with a central protruding keystone, looking down onto the shelf where the tops of three round colored jar lids (orange, red, cream) are visible.
defects: Irregular polygonal geometry tabs or flaps protrude awkwardly from the bottom of the rear wall
blind.height_vs_figure: About one-third the height of the figure (around 1.8 to 2 feet tall) and roughly 2 feet wide.
